findings: The generic executeTree_law/runTree_law commute the actual controller with every primitive draw law; induction generalizes the current cache, so state-dependent control flow is covered.

callback_observe retains the entering physical ledger until projection and invokes the already reviewed exact bounded binary callback law. The uniform marginal is not incorrectly substituted for finite-fuel bounded sampling.
run_bounded_law uses a pointwise observable callback law for every entering ledger, allowing arbitrary correlations between prior data and physical state.
cut_bounded_law maps the full result to its finite Finset cut before using finite-output event comparison. No fictitious Fintype instance is assigned to unbounded result or ledger records.

cut_event_le uses the actual runTree_within budget epochs*(2*n*n), boundedDraw fuel value, and the exact ideal cutTree_law. All restart/default branches are included through the imported controller budget.
limits: This is a read-only source/semantic review; the owner supplies build, axiom audit, kernel replay and exact-commit CI evidence separately.

The theorem concerns the stateful retained data controller's cut law and event error. Charged encoded entry, all-regime guards, repeated selector quality, and machine storage/runtime joins are not established by this file.
Immediate imported identities were inspected and six local sources were matched to exact remote Git tree blob hashes; this is not a fresh whole-project audit.
